title: Functions Quiz 1
description: Find which inputs are allowed and which outputs appear.
instructions: Read each question carefully, then check your answer.
Every question has a trap. Read every word.

questions.question: What is the domain of $f(x)=\sqrt{x-3}$?
questions.explanation: We need $x-3\ge0$, so $x\ge3$. Watch out: zero is allowed under a square root, so $x=3$ is included.

questions.question: What is the domain of $f(x)=\dfrac{1}{x-2}$?
questions.explanation: The denominator must not be zero, so $x\neq2$. Watch out: the excluded value solves $x-2=0$, which is $+2$.

questions.question: What is the domain of $f(x)=\ln(x+1)$?
questions.explanation: We need $x+1>0$, so $x>-1$. Watch out: a log needs a strictly positive input, so $-1$ is excluded.

questions.question: What is the range of $f(x)=x^{2}+1$?
questions.explanation: Since $x^2\ge0$, we get $y\ge1$ and $y=1$ is reached at $x=0$. Watch out: the minimum is $1$, not $0$.

questions.question: What is the range of $f(x)=3-x^{2}$?
questions.explanation: Since $x^2\ge0$, $3-x^2\le3$. Watch out: the minus sign flips the inequality.

questions.question: The domain of $f(x)=\dfrac{1}{\sqrt{x-1}}$ is $x>1$.
questions.explanation: We need $x-1\ge0$ for the root and $\sqrt{x-1}\neq0$ for the denominator, so $x>1$. Watch out: both conditions apply together.

questions.question: The domain of $f(x)=\sqrt{4-x^{2}}$ is $x\le2$.
questions.explanation: We need $4-x^2\ge0$, so $-2\le x\le2$. Watch out: $x=-5$ would make $4-25<0$, so it is not allowed.

questions.question: Evaluate $f(3)$ for $f(x)=\sqrt{x+1}$.
questions.explanation: $\sqrt{3+1}=\sqrt4=2$. Watch out: the square root of $4$ is $2$, not $\pm2$.

questions.question: Which values are **in** the domain of $f(x)=\sqrt{x-3}$?
questions.explanation: Only $x\ge3$ works. Watch out: $x=3$ is included because $\sqrt0=0$ is defined.

questions.question: Match each function with its domain.
questions.explanation: Each function has its own restriction. Watch out: $\ln x$ excludes $0$, but $\sqrt x$ does not.
